title: Projections renderer manifest
description: `renderer.json`, the manifest a renderer bundle ships beside its `index.html`: its name, the definition renderers it presents, and optionally the comparison modes and extractions it supports.

name.description: The bundle directory name, such as `basic`.

title.description: The renderer's name in hosts' messages and menus.

handles.description: The definition renderer names the bundle presents, such as `["graph", "dag"]`.

comparisonModes.description: The comparison modes the bundle supports; absent means side by side, animated and swipe.

accepts.description: The extractions the bundle presents, by domain schema and optional vocabulary; absent means any.
